info.title: Finup Public API
info.description: Client-facing Finup API reference generated from current public endpoint metadata.

tags.name: Accounts
tags.description: Current account, account setup, and account capabilities.

tags.name: Cards
tags.description: Card issuing, listing, funding, and status changes.

get.description: Returns current account limits, capabilities, status, and fees. Unlike most endpoints, the response is not wrapped in `result`.

get.summary: Get card types available for the account

post.description: Filters and pagination are both optional; pagination defaults to page 1, 50 per page. `pagination.total_records` and `pagination.total_pages` are always null here — call POST /transactions/count with the same body for the totals.

post.summary: Refund a deposit blocked by the AML check
post.description:
Sends a crypto deposit that failed the AML check (`deposit_data.aml_declined`, status `declined`) back out to the given address. Nothing was credited, so nothing is taken back. Callable by the member the deposit was addressed to or the account owner, with `can_withdraw` and the same TOTP rule as withdrawals.

Returns as soon as the crypto service accepts the request. The outcome arrives asynchronously: on success the transaction becomes `canceled` and `deposit_data.refund` carries `tx_hash`, `blockchain_url` and the `amount` sent; on failure `deposit_data.refund.status` is `failed` with an `error_code` and the request can be sent again. Poll POST /transactions for the outcome. Finup charges no fee, but the network fee is taken out of the transfer (on Tron up to 3 USDT).

parameters.name: transaction_id
parameters.description: Transaction id of the blocked deposit, from POST /transactions.

400.description: Code missing, or the address is the deposit address, invalid on the deposit network, or belongs to Finup

409.description: The deposit is not refundable, or a refund already exists for it

428.description: 2FA is not enabled for the caller

post.description: Totals for the same filter body POST /transactions takes. Intended to be called in parallel with the page request.
Aggregates the whole filtered set, not just the current page. Card funding and same-account member transfers are net-zero within the account and are excluded from both spent and incoming.
Issues `quantity` cards on one BIN. `balance_type` is required and must be supported by the BIN.

Filters and pagination are both optional; pagination defaults to page 1, 50 per page. Money fields are decimal strings on this endpoint.

`sort_by`: created_at | balance | name | holder | tags | spend | transactions | declined_transactions | decline_rate | fees | average_transaction_amount. holder sorts by the owner's "first last" name, tags by the alphabetically first tag name (case-insensitive). Metric sorts read `metrics_window` (thirty_days when omitted), a card without metrics counts as 0. createdAt desc breaks ties.

summary.description: Present only when `metrics_window` is sent. Totals over the whole filtered set (all pages).

get.description: Returns the full card. PAN, CVV, PIN and the 3DS password are included only for the card holder or a member with `can_manage_team_cards`, and never for a closed card. Seeing another member's card needs `can_see_team_data`.

post.description: Balance cards only — a limit card has no balance to fund.

400.description: Limit card: it has no balance to move

409.description: Card is still processing, or the provider limit update failed

429.description: Another transfer on this card is in progress, retry

post.description: Balance cards only — a limit card has no balance to withdraw from.

400.description: Limit card: it has no balance to move

409.description: Card is still processing, or the provider limit update failed

429.description: Another transfer on this card is in progress, retry

total_records.description: Total matching records. Always null on POST /transactions — call POST /transactions/count for the totals.

status.description: Status of the freshly created account. New accounts start as `pending` until onboarding and the activation deposit are complete.

max_members.description: Team size cap; null = no cap.

max_pending_invites.description: Cap on open team invites; null = no cap.

free_cards.description: The account's free-card grant plus the calling member's own grant. The two are separate pools and both are spendable by this member.

used_free_cards.description: Free cards already spent, summed over the same two pools.

activation_amount.description: Deposit required to activate the account (decimal money string in USD).

hold_amount.description: Amount held and released on activation (decimal money string in USD).

total_hold.description: Total hold released so far, summed from the ledger (decimal money string in USD).

business_access.description: The account's business access AND the calling member's.

advertising_access.description: The account's advertising access AND the calling member's.

platinum_access.description: The account's platinum access AND the calling member's.

negative_balance_autocover.description: Negative card balances are covered automatically out of the cardholder's wallet.

fees.description: Effective fee schedule. Values are stringified verbatim: flat USD amounts and percentages both appear as strings.

total.description: Lifetime account metrics as raw numbers (transactions, approved_transactions, pending_transactions, declined_transactions, spend, deposit, fees, cards, active_cards, auth_rate, recalculated_at). Null until they are first calculated.

filled.description: True once the onboarding questionnaire has been submitted.

id.description: Same value as bin_id, kept for backwards compatibility.

balance_possibility.description: Whether cards on this BIN can run on a stored balance (balance_type "balance").

limit_possibility.description: Whether cards on this BIN can run on a spending limit (balance_type "limit").

id.description: Transaction ids to include. Restricts the result to exactly these transactions; combines (AND) with every other filter.

tag_ids.description: Card tag ids. Keeps only transactions on cards carrying at least one of these tags. Omitted or empty disables tag filtering.

merchant_category.description: Merchant categories (card_transaction_data.merchant_category, exact match, any of). Only card transactions carry a category, so a non-empty value restricts the result to card transactions.

include_transfers.description: Include transfer legs (user_transfer, card_deposit, card_withdraw) in the list.

own.description: Limit results to transactions initiated by the caller.

users.description: Member user ids to include. Available to roles that can see team data.

timezone.description: IANA timezone applied to the date filters.

type.description: What the fee was charged for.

wallet_user_id.description: Whose wallet was the counterparty of the card funding / withdrawal.

status.description: requested — accepted by the crypto service; processing — being sent; completed — sent, see tx_hash and blockchain_url, and the transaction itself is now canceled; failed — nothing left Finup, the deposit is still declined and the refund can be asked for again.

withdraw_address.description: Address the blocked deposit is being sent back to.

amount.description: Amount actually sent back, in the deposit currency. The provider takes the network fee out of the transfer (on Tron up to 3 USDT), so it is only known once the refund is sent.

fee_amount.description: Network fee the provider took out of the transfer, in the deposit currency; null until the refund is sent.

tx_hash.description: Hash of the refund transaction; null until it is confirmed.

blockchain_url.description: Block explorer link for tx_hash, ready to show as-is.

error_code.description: Machine-readable failure reason, null unless status is failed: insufficient_gas, insufficient_balance, transaction_reverted, provider_unavailable or transfer_failed. Map it to your own wording.

fee_amount.description: Network fee the refund is expected to cost, in the deposit currency. Quoted when the deposit was blocked; it can only go down by the time the refund is sent.

net_amount.description: Amount the user is expected to receive: original_amount minus fee_amount.

aml_declined.description: Present and true only on a deposit the AML check blocked. Such a deposit stays in status declined: nothing was credited and the funds are still on the deposit address, waiting to be returned. The risk score behind the decision is never exposed.

withdraw_address.description: Address the deposit is sent back to, on the network it arrived on. Must not be the deposit address itself.

code.description: TOTP code. Required unless the account is suspended or blocked and the user has no 2FA enabled.

amount.description: Decimal money string in USD. For non-fee payments it already includes crossborder fees.

total_amount.description: Payment amount including related fees: same-side fees are added, opposite-side fees subtracted. Decimal money string in USD.

source_identifier.description: Masked PAN for card rows, the member email for wallet rows.

related_fees.description: Same-account fee payments linked to this one. Crossborder fees are not listed here — they are only reflected in amount / total_amount.

rule_execution_id.description: The automation-rule run this row belongs to, null on everything a rule never touched.

net.description: incoming − spent − fees. Decimal money string in USD.

balance_type.description: Keep only cards of these balance models. Pass one ("balance" or "limit") or both.

metrics_window.description: Metrics window. When set, every row carries `period_metrics` and the response carries `summary` over the whole filtered set.

spend.description: Net spend in the window (debits minus refunds). Decimal money string in USD.

average_transaction_amount.description: `spend` / non-declined transactions. Decimal money string in USD.

cards.description: Cards in the whole filtered set.

active_cards.description: Cards with at least one transaction in the window.

balance_type.description: Whether the card runs on a stored balance or a spending limit. The chosen model must be supported by the BIN (see balance_possibility / limit_possibility on GET /bins).

quantity.description: Number of cards to issue. Either quantity or the legacy alias amount must be present.

amount.description: Legacy alias for quantity. Prefer quantity.

limit_amount.description: Spending limit for balance_type "limit". null = unlimited card, 0 = card cannot spend. Ignored for balance cards.

limit_period.description: Reset period of the spending limit. Only for balance_type "limit"; defaults to "all_time" when a limit amount is given without a period. "per_transaction" caps each single operation instead of a rolling window.

limit_amount.description: Spending limit (decimal money string in USD), or null for balance cards and unlimited limit cards.

limit_spent.description: Spend already used in the current limit window. Lifetime total for an unlimited card; null for "per_transaction".

period_metrics.description: Present only when `metrics_window` is sent. Zeros for a card without activity.

deposit.description: Lifetime total deposited to the card.

withdraw.description: Lifetime total withdrawn from the card.

limit_amount.description: Spending limit, or null for balance cards and unlimited limit cards.

3ds_password.description: Static 3DS password of the BIN. Same visibility as PAN, and only on 3DS BINs.

address.example: 2381 Zanker Rd Ste 110, San Jose, CA, 95131, US

PAN.description: Full card number. Only on GET /cards/{card_id}, for the card holder or a member with `can_manage_team_cards`, and never for a closed card.

CVV.description: Card CVV. Same visibility as PAN.

PIN.description: Card PIN when the card has one. Same visibility as PAN.

user_id.description: Whose wallet funds the deposit. Defaults to the caller's own wallet. Another member's wallet needs `can_move_team_funds`.
Whose wallet receives the funds. Defaults to the caller's own wallet. Another member's wallet needs `can_move_team_funds`.
